answer: An economy of AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by routing computational tasks through a cryptographic inlet that requires verifiable resource stakes for each participating node. To prevent identity flooding, every transactional thread must be anchored to a scarce, burned cryptographic pearl representing proof-of-work or proof-of-stake. This imposes a strict economic cost on an attacker, scaling linearly with the number of generated fake identities and rendering mass infiltration economically unviable.
